name: LUSTIFY! [NSFW checkpoint]
description:
Update 10.07.2026. Lustify V10 (Krea 2) IS OUT!
Recommended workflow.

Alternative Access & Support: Outside of CivitAI's Early Access, you can get the model via my Boosty.
As always, after the early access ends, there will be a 2-week period where the model is available for "on-site generation only." After that, it will become available for everyone to download. The open release date: 10/08/2026 (10th of August).
Alternatively, you can make a direct Bitcoin (BTC) donation, just make sure to DM me after that: 1CoMZvrXtRXbz7BCzdvxifSjHqhaf1yUZs

LUSTIFY

Lustify is a photoreal checkpoint optimized for creating high-quality imagery of women in explicit/sexual scenarios. The model has been trained on a hybrid dataset, meaning it natively understands both Danbooru tags and natural language prompting.

Note: While it has a strong NSFW bias, if you guide it properly, it is fully capable of generating stunning SFW photography, objects, animals, and fantasy environments.

Crucial Points Before You Download:

  1. NOT Pony or Illustrious-Based: This is a standard SDXL checkpoint. Do not use Pony/Illustrious LoRAs with it; they will not work correctly.

  2. Distant Shots & Anatomy Limitations: Like 99% of SDXL models, distant shots can sometimes suffer from distorted faces or hands. This is an inherent limitation of the base technology (4 channel VAE), not the finetune. It is incredibly easy to fix using Inpainting or ADetailer. Please utilize these tools rather than reporting this as a bug.

  3. Experimental Nature: My training workflow involves a lot of unconventional, high-risk experimentation. Because of this, some prompt combinations that worked perfectly on other checkpoints might behave differently here. If you encounter unexpected behavior, feel free to give feedback so I can look into it.


Recomended parameters:
Sampler: DPM++ 2M SDE/DPM++ 3M SDE,
Scheduler: Exponential/Karras
Steps: 30
Cfg: 2.5-4.5.
Highres.fix: upscale by 1.4-1.5, denoising ~0.4
For the distant shots of people you probably wanna use highres.fix and/or adetailer.

Also, use reasonable positive/negative prompts, shizoprompting does more harm than good (with any SDXL model).

Some tags that have a big visual impact with this model:

  1. Camera type tags: "shot on Polaroid SX-70", "shot on Kodak Funsaver", "shot on GoPro Hero", "shot on Canon EOS 5D", "shot on Leica T".

  2. Photography styles: "analog photo", "glamour photography", "street fashion photography", "candid photo", "amateur photo".

  3. Lighting types: "cinematic lighting", "neon lighting", "soft lighting", "dramatic lighting", "low key lighting", "bright flash photography", "warm golden hour lighting", "radiant god rays".

  4. Film types: "Ilford HP5 Plus", "Lomochrome color film", "Fujicolor Pro".

  5. Photographers: Alessio Albi, Martin Schoeller, Miles Aldridge, Oleg Oprisco, Tim Walker.

  6. Others: "film grain", "bokeh", "dreamy haze", "technicolor", "underexposed", "low quality", "lowres"

Alternatively, you can give a read to this wonderful prompting guide by PromptGeek. It has A LOT of useful tips I didn't know about even after years of using SD.

modelVersions.name: v10 (Krea 2)
modelVersions.description:
Available Model Variants:

  • Raw: fp16 / fp8 / int8_convrot

  • Turbo: fp16 / fp8 / int8_convrot / Q4 GGUF / Q2 GGUF (my custom implementation)

Hardware Recommendations:

  • 4 GB VRAM: Either Q2 or Q4 GGUF variant.

  • 8 GB VRAM: Your best bet is the Turbo Q4 GGUF variant.

  • 12 GB VRAM (or if you don't mind slightly longer generation times): Go with either Turbo int8_convrot (after the latest Comfy optimizations this is the preferred variant) or Turbo fp8.

  • 24 GB VRAM: You can comfortably run the full Turbo fp16 variant.

Use Turbo for everyday inference (generation) and Raw if you plan on training or fine-tuning.

modelVersions.name: APEX 🎨INPAINTING🎨
modelVersions.description: Even though V8 Apex was trained on 1536 resolution, the inpainting version didn't inherit it that much, use that res on your own risk :P. You can use it for the refinement pass though!

modelVersions.name: GGWP (V7)
modelVersions.description: Honestly, I can't recomend enough using it paired with DMD2 lora - it's both faster and fixes the small issues with faces/hands/etc. And now that NAG (Normalized Attention Guidance) exists, you can also utilize your negative prompts with it.

modelVersions.name: OLT (FIXED TEXTURES)
modelVersions.description: It's the same as first OLT, but has proper textures.

modelVersions.name: OLT 🎨INPAINTING🎨
modelVersions.description: You know what this is and what it is for. I know you do ;)

modelVersions.name: ENDGAME ⚡DMD2⚡
modelVersions.description:
This isn't a lightning, but DMD2 model. For those who don't know, it's purpose is the same as Lightning/Hyper, but with a different look. I found that DMD2 works best for V5.

Recomended parameters:

LCM + Exponential/Karras scheduler,

4-8 Steps,

1-1.3 CFG.

Highres fix: upscale by 1.4, 2-3 highres steps, 0.45 denoising.

If you get any mutations, try changing the amount of steps and/or scheduler

modelVersions.name: v4.0 alpha
modelVersions.description:
1) This is my gratitude to everyone supporting me and my work. I truly appreciate you guys!

3) In my tests, V4 is the best of all the versions. But that's when it comes to my usage - it may be different for you.

modelVersions.name: v2.0 alpha
modelVersions.description:
1) I've trained the model for additional ~26 535 steps on a completely new set of pictures.
2) Better style variety, way better natural language prompt understanding, better prompt adherence, better SFW.
3) BUT! Hardcore scenes are now less consistent (you can still get them right, but it will take more rerolls). I wanted to fix that, but honestly I got too exhausted from working on V2. Sorry guys, probably not the update you expected, but it's definitely the update the checkpoint needs.
For V2 I've merged V1 with NatVis (20%) and then trained on new 1700 pics for additional 26 535 steps.

modelVersions.name: v2.0 ⚡LIGHTNING⚡
modelVersions.description:
Lightning version.

Recomended parameters:

  1. DPM++ SDE

  2. Karras / Exponential scheduler

  3. 4 Steps

  4. Cfg: 1-2.

  5. Highres.fix: upscale by 1.4, 2 steps, denoising ~0.4, upscale model "nmkd siax" or "nmkd superscale"

Due the nature of "lightning" models, this version might follow your prompts worse then the regular one. Also, I've noticed that the lighting type tags need more weight in this version, for example "(neon lighting:1.3), (cinematic lighting:1.1)".
